correctness.rationale: The norm is exactly the supremum of the established Mellin spectral multiplier. Separating positive left and right cross integrals gives a strictly increasing A/B ratio and a unique nondegenerate maximizing frequency for every lambda>-1. Uniform endpoint Watson estimates and a central Laplace saddle yield the stated order-one frequency correction and precise exponentially small leakage coefficient. Four intervals and four weights passed 89 standalone finite numerical diagnostics; those finite tests are not used as infinite proofs.

Prior qualitative large-weight concentration does not quantify the exponentially small residual or the best Mellin balance.
